'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I need your help again, brother. You really came through for me with that backpack and mask. This time, I need some specific rigs. I want to test a few things before releasing my own versions... Ahem, alright, I won't bore you with the details. I'll tell you later, don't want to jinx it!}}

==Objectives==
* Find 2 [[WARTECH TV-109 + TV-106 chest rig (A-TACS FG)|WARTECH TV-109 + TV-106 chest rigs]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the chest rigs
* Find 2 [[BlackRock chest rig (Gray)|BlackRock chest rigs]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the chest rigs

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[6B5-15 Zh-86 Uley armored rig (Flora)]]
* Unlocks craft for [[6B23-2 body armor (Mountain Flora)]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Lavatory level 1]]
{{quote|Much appreciated, brother! Leave them here. And here's your reward.}}
